messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high latency on /v1/embeddings for customer clusters in us-west-2. Severity: SEV2. Trigger: queue length > 3000. Paging sre-oncall. details: https://incidents/redwood/4067772468 :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: taking it. looking at k8s pod autoscaler and embedder queue.

alex.k: saw a spike in tokenization time in recent deploy? rolling back not yet, collecting traces.

maria.p: customer impact estimate: ~12% of embedding requests delayed > 2s during spike, some rate-limited errors. Affected tier: hosted customers on standard plan.

emily: confirming region scope: only us-west-2 so far. probing other regions.

incident-bot: Live mitigation checklist created: 
- add temporary capacity (scale up pool)
- enable fallback model for standard tier
- enable prefix cache for hot keys
Actioning: sre-oncall, alex.k.

jon.d: started scale-up of dedicated pool + bumped HPA min replicas. watching CPU/GPU queue.

alex.k: rolling back last runtime change (tiny tokenizer fix) to rule out regression.

sre-oncall: CPU looks normal, KV cache evictions high. applying aggressive TTL bump for embedder cache.

maria.p: notifying customers impacted by increased latency and crediting minor usage if they hit 2s+ SLA. draft notice: "We're investigating intermittent embedding latency in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress."

product-ops: please add a postmortem and link to this thread once stable. Assigning PM for customer comms.

eng-lead: if rollback stabilizes, schedule postmortem for next-day sync. Need action items: root cause, capacity plan, cache tuning, playbook updates.

incident-bot: Mitigation update: latency reduced to baseline after rollback + cache TTL bump. Error rate down. Marking incident as mitigated (4067772699).

sre-oncall: confirming mitigation holds for 10m. Looks stable. Preparing post-incident notes.

maria.p: thanks. Please kick off postmortem scheduling. Who can take ownership of write-up?

alex.k: I can own root-cause writeup + logs. estimate 4-6h. Tags: eng-runtime, eng-ml.

jon.d: I'll own capacity/ops action items (HPA tuning, autoscale thresholds). estimate 3-5h.

emily: I'll take customer-impact summary + comms follow-ups. estimate 1-2h.

product-ops: assigning postmortem meeting: propose 2026-04-02 15:00 PT. Please ack or suggest.

eng-lead: ack. Add severity-based prioritization for action items:
- P0 (must in next sprint): autoscale thresholds + immediate cache defaults (jon.d)
- P1 (this quarter): playbook + better hot-key telemetry (alex.k + eng-ml)
- P2 (next quarter): capacity simulation and cost tradeoffs (product-ops + eng-lead)

maria.p: adding discrete action items (format: id | owner | size | due | priority):
- A1 | jon.d | small | 1w | P0 -- adjust HPA, increase pool warmup
- A2 | alex.k | medium | 2w | P1 -- investigate tokenizer regression traces + improved rollout gating
- A3 | emily | small | 3d | P0 -- customer notices + credit reconciliation
- A4 | eng-lead | medium | 4w | P1 -- update runbook and oncall playbook steps
- A5 | product-ops | large | q2 | P2 -- capacity planning exercise and cost model

jon.d: A1 in my board, blocked on infra quota approval. pinging cloud-ops.

alex.k: A2 estimate 12 dev-hours + 4 hours for test validation. I'll split into sub-tasks.

emily: A3 done (draft sent to legal), will publish after review.

product-ops: linking postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/4067772468. Please add notes and update task statuses.

sre-oncall: final: add retrospective item to Q2 planning: dedicated warm pool for embeddings in high-traffic windows.

maria.p: thanks everyone. Closing mitigation phase. Postmortem meeting confirmed. We'll track A1-A5 in sprint board and review in next all-hands. :white_check_mark:
